title: Self Publish, Be Happy
one_sentence: International independent publishing platform and community focused on artist books, zines, workshops, and artist visibility.
why_this_fits_short: Strong fit for an artist whose work can live as quiet artist-book or zine sequences — atmospheric watercolor work translates well to the printed object.
quick_action: Research current submission, workshop, and publication opportunities; identify whether portfolio review or newsletter visibility is available.
three_bullets: Strong international artist-book and independent publishing credibility.
Good fit for quiet image sequences and book-thinking.
More strategic than a one-off local wall show if publication is the goal.

title: Printed Matter Art Book Fairs
one_sentence: Major international art-book nonprofit and fair organizer with strong relevance to artist books, zines, and printed matter.
why_this_fits_short: Highly relevant if her watercolor work develops into books, zines, calendars, or small editions; likely a long-term rather than immediate target.
quick_action: Research fair exhibitor criteria and identify comparable small publishers or artists first.
three_bullets: Top-tier printed matter relevance.
Strong long-term target for artist-book positioning.
Probably requires a stronger publication object before applying.

title: Offprint
one_sentence: International art publishing fair focused on independent, experimental, and artist-led publishing.
why_this_fits_short: Good fit if her atmospheric watercolor work is developed into printed matter, especially artist books or quiet intimate publications.
quick_action: Research exhibitor criteria, fees, and past participants before treating this as actionable.
three_bullets: Strong artist-book and independent publishing fit.
International credibility beyond local Tokyo opportunities.
Likely better after creating a clear publication object.

title: Center for Book Arts Opportunities
one_sentence: Book arts institution with exhibitions, residencies, education, and opportunities connected to artist books and printed matter.
why_this_fits_short: Potential fit if her watercolor work becomes more explicitly book-oriented or object/paper based.
quick_action: Check current opportunities, eligibility, and whether international artists may apply.
three_bullets: Useful bridge between watercolor practice and book form.
May suit artist-book development more than standard gallery exposure.
Eligibility and location constraints need verification.

title: Royal Watercolour Society Open Exhibition
one_sentence: The world's oldest and most prestigious watercolor society, holding annual open exhibitions open to non-member artists internationally.
why_this_fits_short: Direct medium match — the RWS open exhibition is the most prestigious international platform for watercolor painting, and acceptance is a major CV milestone.
quick_action: Research current open call dates, submission fees, accepted formats, and previous selected works to gauge aesthetic fit.
three_bullets: Highest prestige watercolor exhibition in the world — acceptance is career-defining.
Open to international non-member artists, making it accessible.
Directly strengthens the CV ahead of the deep-work year at 30.

title: American Watercolor Society Annual International Exhibition
one_sentence: The most prominent annual international watercolor exhibition in North America, open to artists worldwide.
why_this_fits_short: Direct medium match and major international credibility — AWS is recognized globally as a benchmark for serious watercolor practice.
quick_action: Check current open call window, digital vs. physical submission requirements, fees, and accepted paper sizes.
three_bullets: One of the most recognized international watercolor credentials available.
Accepts entries from artists worldwide — no geographic restriction.
Strong alignment with works on paper, intimate scale, and atmospheric painting.

title: Cité Internationale des Arts Artist Residency
one_sentence: Major international artist residency in Paris offering studio housing to artists from around the world, with strong track record for Asian artists.
why_this_fits_short: Prestigious, Paris-based, and actively accessible to artists from Asia — a residency here would be a major career milestone and exposure to the European gallery ecosystem.
quick_action: Research application routes (often via home country cultural institutions or direct application), eligibility, and current availability.
three_bullets: Highly prestigious and internationally recognized as a serious residency.
Well-established pipeline for artists from China and Japan.
Paris location opens European gallery and publishing contacts.

title: Japan Watercolor Society Annual Exhibition
organization: 日本水彩画会 (Japan Watercolor Society)
one_sentence: Japan's primary professional watercolor society, holding annual exhibitions at major Tokyo venues open to non-member entries.
why_this_fits_short: The principal professional watercolor body in Japan — entry and acceptance builds local credibility and professional peer relationships within the Tokyo watercolor world.
quick_action: Research current membership structure, open entry process, exhibition dates, and submission requirements in Japanese.
three_bullets: Core professional watercolor institution in Japan — presence here matters locally.
Accessible with N2 Japanese and Tokyo residency.
Builds the peer and professional relationships needed for the long term.

title: Aesthetica Art Prize
one_sentence: Annual international art prize open to all media — painting, works on paper, digital, and more — with strong emerging artist track record.
why_this_fits_short: Open to watercolor and works on paper, internationally recognized, and has a track record of selecting intimate and atmospheric work by emerging artists.
quick_action: Check current open call, entry fees, accepted categories, and whether works on paper / watercolor have historically been selected.
three_bullets: Open to all media — no photography-only bias.
International visibility for emerging artists without gallery prerequisite.
Fee/value ratio and past winners should be checked before submitting.

title: Asian Cultural Council Fellowship
one_sentence: Prestigious grant program supporting cultural exchange for artists and arts professionals from Asia, enabling research, residency, and travel internationally.
why_this_fits_short: Directly designed for artists from Asia building international careers — a fellowship would fund research travel, residency, and international network-building at exactly the right career stage.
quick_action: Research current fellowship categories, eligibility (Chinese national based in Japan qualifies), application cycle, and past recipients in painting/works on paper.
three_bullets: Purpose-built for artists in her exact situation — Asian artist seeking international career development.
High prestige and strong network of alumni across Asia and the US.
Fellowship support could fund the deep-work year or international residency she is planning.
